STYLE CORE (ASHLAR art direction, mandatory): moderately stylized hand-painted dark fantasy in the spirit of Diablo Immortal (the Diablo III / Diablo Immortal family look). NOT photoreal, NOT Diablo IV realism, NOT cartoon, chibi, anime, cel-shaded or toy-like. Proportions follow real anatomy; exaggeration goes only to the identity features (heroes: hands, feet and class props slightly oversized; monsters: their signature features pushed further). Strong readable silhouette, clear value grouping, clean colour blocking: a dominant colour, a secondary colour and a small accent, plus neutrals. Surfaces are SIMPLE: broad painted planes with soft gradients and a few crisp highlights; detail comes from big shapes (large torn edges, plates, straps, bones, cracks, patches), never from texture. No micro texture: no pores, fabric weave, leather grain, scratches, stains, speckle noise, fine grunge or photoreal PBR. Low detail never means flat: keep clear 3D form shading with a lit side, a shadow side, big soft fold shadows and darker occlusion in deep folds. No black cartoon outlines.

CONTENT: no crosses, no real saints, prayers or religious symbols; ASHLAR's church sign is the Wedge (a keystone shape), only where the brief asks for it. No gore emphasis and no blood splatter (Act III blood accents are small painted stains only); heroes show no wounds and no blood. Adults only; no nudity, no anatomical detail, no sexualised poses; no likeness of any real person. Never stage hanged bodies.

IMAGE FOR A 3D MODEL GENERATOR (single-image to 3D): ONE single isolated object, centred: a single adult human FOREARM AND HAND with its sleeve cuff, nothing else. The forearm ends in a clean flat straight cut through the sleeve about 25 cm behind the wrist (this end will be set into a wall); the cut end is a plain flat cap in the sleeve colour, never an open hole, no arm, shoulder or body. Camera: a three-quarter view from slightly above and to the side (about 25 degrees above, the forearm turned about 40 degrees from the camera axis) so the full length of the forearm, the whole hand and every finger are clearly readable; the whole object inside the frame with a generous margin on every side. Perfectly flat plain light grey #BDBDBD background: no wall, no skulls, no candle, no floor, no cast shadow, no other objects, no text, no labels, no frame. The fingers are slightly spread with a clear gap of background between every finger and the thumb, none touching or overlapping another; fingers chunky and readable, slightly oversized hero hands. No thin floating bits (no loose thread ends, hair-thin strands, dust or particles); bracelets, cords and rings hug the wrist and fingers tightly as solid chunky shapes. One neutral white light from above and slightly in front, clear 3D form shading (lit side, shadow side, darker occlusion between fingers and under the cuff); NOT the warm candle light of the reference: neutral local colours. Matte surfaces.

IDENTITY REFERENCE: the attached image is a crop of our approved key art (six hands reaching out of a skull wall, lit by one candle). Recreate exactly this hand: same design, gesture, finger pose, gauntlet/glove/sleeve shapes, markers, materials and colours; do not redesign it. Ignore the skull wall, the neighbouring hands, the darkness and the warm candle cast of the reference: they are not part of the object.
